name: xyz.localprotocol.delivery.food
title: Food Delivery Standard
description: Industry standard defining event vocabulary for restaurant and food delivery.

order_placed.description: Order has been placed with the merchant

ready_for_pickup.description: Order is ready for courier pickup

courier_assigned.description: Courier has been assigned to the delivery

courier_at_pickup.description: Courier has arrived at the pickup location

picked_up.description: Order has been picked up by courier

in_transit.description: Order is in transit to delivery location

courier_at_dropoff.description: Courier has arrived at the delivery location

delivered.description: Order has been delivered to recipient
